newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Interpump shares offered at 5,800 lire.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Interpump shares offered at 5,800 lire.

text.p: Italian company Interpump will offer ordinary shares at 5,800 lire each in its public offering on December 5 and 6, a statement from the company said.

Interpump, which makes high-pressure piston pumps and cleaning machines, said the price was the same for the public sale offer (OPV) in Italy, which would also include a tranche reserved for employees, and for a private placement aimed at Italian and international institutional investors.
The OPV, which concerns a minimum 8.0 million shares, represents around 31 percent of the global offer.
The previously announced offer price range had been set at between 5,700 and 6,700 lire.

Interpump said in a statement the price was fixed taking into account market conditions and requests received by Goldman Sachs, global coordinator and lead manager in Italy and abroad, and Banca Commerciale Italiana, OPV lead manager in Italy.
Interpump is expected to debut on the Milan bourse in the week of December 16.

Interpump, which will be the 14th offering on the bourse this year, is currently 80 percent owned by private group BC Partners, with the rest owned by Banca Commerciale Italiana, management and private investors.
